**Interviewer:** Thank you for joining us. For the record, please confirm your name and role.

**Priya Anand:** I’m Priya Anand, and I’m the Lead Grader.

**Interviewer:** This is the first interview session, held on 2026-10-08. To begin, how would you describe the current grading workload?

**Priya Anand:** The workload is manageable when the rota provides enough protected time. The backlog tends to build when we lose hours, rather than simply because clinics become busier. Once the queue starts growing, it takes sustained effort to bring it back under control.

**Interviewer:** Is there a particular change that you think is relevant to that pattern?

**Priya Anand:** The change log calls it 'Grader rota moved to long sessions'. The intention was to create longer, more focused periods for grading. In practice, the effect has not been uniform across the team. Longer sessions can help with continuity, but they can also make disagreements more visible if people are working through more material at a stretch.

**Interviewer:** What did you observe in relation to disagreement?

**Priya Anand:** My audit shows Elif Sahin's disagreement going from about 15% to 35% after the rota change on 2024-03-04. I would not treat that figure as an explanation on its own, but it is a clear signal that the change needs to be examined alongside the work mix, supervision, and how second reads were allocated.

**Interviewer:** How has agency cover affected the workload?

**Priya Anand:** It has helped with volume, particularly when the queue is under pressure. Agency graders started on 2025-01-06 and have read 8333 encounters; I second-read a lot of them. That has given me direct visibility of the consistency of the work, as well as adding to my own review workload.

**Interviewer:** Is there anything else you would want recorded from this session?

**Priya Anand:** Only that capacity and quality need to be considered together. Reducing the queue is useful, but the review arrangements have to keep pace with it.

**Interviewer:** Thank you. We will follow up by email.
